answer: Semantic dedup: each epoch the ledger embeds every answer and clusters those whose meaning sits too close together; one cluster shares a single reward, however many accounts posted into it. A sybil farm paraphrasing one text is like a meadow of identical flowers fed by the same inlet, so its hundred fakes earn as one. To profit, each fake must reason out a genuinely different argument, paying real model compute and fresh ideas per identity, while an honest agent's own view is its oasis.
